Class SshTtyConnector

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshTtyConnector
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.jediterm.terminal.TtyConnector
public class SshTtyConnector extends Object implements com.jediterm.terminal.TtyConnector
The SshTtyConnector connects JediTerm, the terminal widget, to an Apache MINA SSHD shell channel. Keyboard bytes are written to the channel's inverted standard input. Remote output is read from the channel's inverted standard output. AMWP is the framed protocol carried on that same channel. An Init reply that is not a valid 0xAE frame leaves the connector in raw mode. In AMWP mode, JediTerm sees only Scope T octets. Scope T is the terminal channel inside an AMWP frame.
Author:
clayl (2026-08-24)

    • SshTtyConnector

      public SshTtyConnector(String name, org.apache.sshd.client.SshClient client, org.apache.sshd.client.session.ClientSession session, org.apache.sshd.client.channel.ChannelShell channel)
      The constructor stores the open shell and prepares a raw UTF-8 reader on its inverted output. AMWP is off until tryAmwpInit() succeeds. The held-frame list starts empty.
      Parameters:
      name - The name is the display name, usually the user, the remote address, and the port.
      client - The client is the started Apache MINA SSHD client.
      session - The session is the authenticated SSH session.
      channel - The channel is the open shell channel that uses inverted streams.

  • Method Details

    • tryAmwpInit

      public void tryAmwpInit()
      The method sends a client Init frame and switches to AMWP only when a valid reply arrives. The reply magic byte is 0xAE. A timeout, a closed stream, or any other failure leaves a raw PTY reader. A PTY is the remote terminal allocated for the shell. The method writes an Init frame on Scope A. The method waits up to the Init wait for the first byte. A timeout or a negative read installs a raw reader on the peeked stream and returns. A first byte that is not magic is pushed back onto that raw stream. A magic byte is completed into a header. A header read that ends early installs the raw reader and returns. An Init frame stores session facts from AmwpToon.decodeFacts(byte[]). An empty Init body is not reported as facts. An Init frame or a Data frame calls enterMux(). A Scope T payload on that first frame is queued for JediTerm. Any other parsed type is not treated as a successful handshake. An exception clears the AMWP flag and leaves the raw reader.

    • sessionFacts

      public AmwpToon.SessionFacts sessionFacts()
      The method returns the server facts taken from an Init frame. The value stays null until a server answers with Init. AmwpToon.decodeFacts(byte[]) does not report an empty body.
      Returns:
      The return value is the stored facts, or null.

    • setAmwpListener

      public void setAmwpListener(AmwpClientListener listener)
      The method stores the Scope A listener. A null listener holds later frames on this session. A non-null listener receives every frame that was held while it was away. Those held frames are cleared before they are delivered.
      Parameters:
      listener - The listener is the Scope A sink, or null to hold frames.

    • writeAmwp

      public void writeAmwp(int type, byte[] payload) throws IOException
      The method writes one Scope A frame. The channel is the Scope A channel. Raw mode does not write the frame. Raw mode throws IOException.
      Parameters:
      type - The type is the AMWP frame type.
      payload - The payload is the frame body.
      Throws:
      IOException - The exception is thrown when AMWP was not negotiated or the write fails.

    • writeAmwp

      public void writeAmwp(int channel, int type, byte[] payload) throws IOException
      The method writes one AMWP frame on the given channel. Scope A execute stays on channel 0x0002. Tool frames use channel 0x0004. The method throws IOException with the text AMWP not negotiated when AMWP is off. The write is serialized on the write lock.
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the AMWP channel number.
      type - The type is the AMWP frame type.
      payload - The payload is the frame body.
      Throws:
      IOException - The exception is thrown when AMWP is off or the write fails.

    • read

      public int read(char[] buf, int offset, int length) throws IOException
      The method reads characters for JediTerm from the current reader. In raw mode the reader is the shell output. In AMWP mode the reader is the Scope T queue.
      Specified by:
      read in interface com.jediterm.terminal.TtyConnector
      Parameters:
      buf - The buffer receives the characters.
      offset - The offset is the first index to fill.
      length - The length is the maximum number of characters to read.
      Returns:
      The return value is the count from the reader, or -1 at the end of the stream.
      Throws:
      IOException - The exception is thrown when the reader throws.

    • write

      public void write(byte[] bytes) throws IOException
      The method writes terminal bytes to the shell. A null array returns without a write. An empty array returns without a write. AMWP mode wraps the bytes as a Scope T data frame. Raw mode writes the bytes to the inverted input and flushes that stream.
      Specified by:
      write in interface com.jediterm.terminal.TtyConnector
      Parameters:
      bytes - The bytes are the terminal payload.
      Throws:
      IOException - The exception is thrown when the write fails.

      public void resize(com.jediterm.core.util.TermSize termSize)
      The method tells the server the new terminal size. A null size returns without a request. A connector that is not connected returns without a request. A failed window-change write is ignored. A dead channel shows up on the next read.
      Specified by:
      resize in interface com.jediterm.terminal.TtyConnector

    • close

      public void close()
      The method closes the connector once. A second call returns immediately. The keepalive timer is cancelled when one exists. An empty chunk is queued so a blocked Scope T read can finish. The demux thread is interrupted when it exists. closeQuietly() then closes the channel, the session, and the client.
      Specified by:
      close in interface com.jediterm.terminal.TtyConnector
